compiled_state.title: Reconcile test-/test_ naming split so underscore tests are discovered (Finding 6 part 4)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: External review Finding 6 follow-up. tests/lib/run-script-tests.sh discovers only test-*.sh (hyphen); underscore-named test_*.sh files (tests/scripts/test_write_cycle_ledger_v110.sh, tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd5_bundle.sh, tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh) are never run by the bash suite. The TMPDIR-isolation lint glob was broadened to cover them (PR for Finding 6), but DISCOVERY was not. Evidence of bit-rot: tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh has a PRE-EXISTING failing assertion ('strict + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset') confirmed failing on unmodified HEAD — it has been silently un-run. Scope: (1) decide whether each test_*.sh should run (rename to test-*.sh) or be retired; (2) fix or delete the failing bridge-imports test; (3) align run-script-tests.sh discovery with the lint glob. NOTE: bridge-imports test touches reconciler logic — coordinate with the CI/PR session.

comments.body: Discovery half resolved in commits c19f8ae4d3 + 21ca6dde43 (local; pending merge): run-script-tests.sh now discovers test[-_]*.sh in tests/scripts + plugin + scratch AND all of tests/unit/** via find. The 2 hidden failures (tracked in badf-298f-ade3-40f1) are fixed. Remaining: this also subsumes the test-/test_ naming concern (both namings now discovered, so renaming is no longer required). Leaving OPEN until merged to main.
